facts.business: NAPS Global India Limited is a wholesale importer of textile products, primarily importing cotton and man-made fabrics from China and Hong Kong in bulk quantities and supplying them to garment manufacturing vendors in Maharashtra, India.

segments.name: Wholesale import and supply of textile fabrics
